thread:
alex: starting a progressive cutover for model v3b-quant-int8 at 10% traffic now. goal: validate quality and cost under real traffic before wide release.

maya: nice. what automated signals are we gating on for cutover?

alex: high-level: 1) low_confidence_rate (per-request) 2) latency 95p 3) regression hits on prompt-regression-suite v2. automatic throttle if low_confidence_rate spikes.

jun: how are we defining low_confidence here? model logit-based? calibrated probs?

alex: using the existing calibration hook that maps logits to confidence. it's the same scoring we used in eval pipeline. threshold candidate = 0.06 (6%) low_conf flags.

kevin: i'd prefer a sliding-window rule: if low_confidence_rate > 0.06 for 15m AND delta_vs-control > +2% absolute, then step traffic down by 50%. soft-sink to 0 over 5 steps.

maya: also watch generation-length drift and hallucination markers from our evals. we had a quant experiment produce longer trailing hallucinations once.

alex: agreed. add two safety checks: gen_length_95p and halluc_flag_rate. fallback if halluc_flag_rate > 0.01 for 30m.

deploy-bot: release-event: rollout v3b-quant-int8 -> subset=10% triggered by alex at 1972345678

sre-ops: log note: will autocapture traces on any threshold breach, set retention 48h.

jun: can we see the config snippet for the gate? i'll add it to the dashboard and alert rules.

alex: here's the draft gate config (will push to infra repo):

```yaml
cutover_policy:
  initial_traffic: 0.10
  step_scale: 0.5  # multiply traffic by this on breach
  evaluation_window: 900s  # 15 minutes
  metrics:
    - name: low_confidence_rate
      threshold: 0.06
      comparator: gt
    - name: delta_vs_control.low_confidence_rate
      threshold: 0.02
      comparator: gt
    - name: latency.p95_ms
      threshold: 200
      comparator: gt
    - name: halluc_flag_rate
      threshold: 0.01
      comparator: gt
  recovery:
    cooldown: 1800s
    growth: 1.25  # increase traffic by 25% after stable window
  hard_cut: 0.0  # sink to zero if persistent failure
```

kevin: I like the cooldown and growth knobs. make sure the dashboard exposes the exact control cohort (same prompts) so delta_vs-control is apples-to-apples.

maya: for the initial 10% we should also enable shadow comparison for 24h to get per-prompt diffs even on non-user-visible outputs. this will help tune halluc_flag heuristics.

alex: enabling shadow-run. also toggling token-cost sampling so FinOps can see real unit costs.

jun: post-mortem plan if we hit hard_cut: capture 1k failing prompts, run locally with full fp16 model and quantized model to see divergence, produce eval runbook (auto).

alex: yes — automated debugger job will collect those and tag with request metadata.

deploy-bot: metric-alert: low_confidence_rate exceeded 0.06 on rollout group at 1972348200. current traffic scaled -> 5%

kevin: good. can we get the per-segment breakdown? mobile web vs api vs embed clients?

alex: posting table to #observability in 5. early signal shows spike concentrated on long-chat sessions (history length > 2k tokens).

maya: ok let's throttle and run targeted tests with longer contexts. might be quant artifact with kv-cache alignment.

jun: adding a temporary override: route long-context requests to v3b-fp16 baseline until we confirm. config pushed.

alex: thanks. next steps: 1) run target tests for 4h 2) collect shadow diffs 3) decide widen -> 25% OR revert to baseline. will update in 2h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

kevin: +1. please include cost delta and per-prompt BLEU/ROUGE deltas in the summary.

maya: and add a quick sanity check script for ops to re-run failing prompts locally (one-liner).

alex: will do. ping me if you see anything strange.
